marks.gloss_en: [aliba Rebbi] 'kadosh' (Deut 14:21) / 'kadesh' (Deut 23:18): as there benefit, so here benefit
and Rebbi -- benefit, from where? he derives it from 'kadosh' (Deut 14:21) / 'kadesh' (Deut 23:18): as there [it concerns] benefit, so here benefit
'holy people' (Deut 14:21) / 'holy men ... tereifa you shall not eat' (Ex 22:30): as there forbidden, so here forbidden
Isi ben Yehuda: from where is meat in milk forbidden? 'holy' here (Deut 14:21) and 'holy men ... do not eat tereifa' (Ex 22:30): as there forbidden, so here forbidden
if orla, with which no sin was done, is forbidden for benefit -- meat in milk, with which a sin was done, is it not right that it be forbidden for benefit?
מה לערלה שכן לא היתה לה שעת הכושר -- what of orla? it never had a time of fitness
chametz on Pesach proves it: it had a time of fitness and is forbidden for benefit
if orla, with which no sin was done, is forbidden both to eat and for benefit -- meat in milk, with which a sin was done, is it not right that it be forbidden both to eat and for benefit?
plowing with ox and donkey, muzzling and threshing prove it: a sin was done with them, and they are permitted (a יוכיח counter-instance)
let orla prove it [against chametz's karet], the argument revert, and [benefit] come by מה הצד from orla and chametz
Rav Ashi: nevela proves it -- forbidden to eat and permitted for benefit (= p_nevela_mutar_behanaa)
Rav Ashi: nevela proves it -- forbidden to eat and permitted for benefit
Rav Mordechai in Reish Lakish's name: any מה הצד is refuted from its own body, not from outside (= p_rm_mah_hatzad_migufo)
Rav Mordechai in Reish Lakish's name: any מה הצד -- we refute it from its own body, we do not refute it from outside
מה להצד השוה שבהן שכן גידולי קרקע -- what of their common factor? they are growths of the ground
אי הכי, השתא נמי איכא למיפרך: מה לכלאי הכרם שכן גידולי קרקע -- attacks the kilei-hakerem step's force as a יוכיח (not the benefit ban on kilei hakerem itself)
Rav Mordechai in Reish Lakish's name: a מה הצד is refuted by anything; one-from-one only by leniency and stringency, not by anything (= p_rm_chada_mechada)
Rav Mordechai in Reish Lakish's name: any מה הצד we refute by anything at all
וליפרוך לכולהו: then refute them all -- what of all of them, they are growths of the ground! [kilei hakerem is not one-from-one but joined to orla and chametz]
Rebbi: 'you shall not eat it' (Deut 12:25) -- the verse speaks of meat in milk
Rebbi (cont.): meat in milk, or any of the Torah's prohibitions? a matter learned from its context: the context speaks of two kinds, so here too two kinds
had it been from that [verse], I would say this is for eating but not for benefit -- [u-vashel mevushal] teaches us [benefit]
the school of R' Eliezer: 'you shall not eat any nevela ... or sell it to a foreigner ... do not cook a kid' (Deut 14:21) -- the Torah said: when you sell it, do not cook it [in milk] and sell it
the school of R' Yishmael: 'do not cook a kid in its mother's milk' three times -- one for the eating ban, one for the benefit ban, one for the cooking ban
Isi: mixed kinds of the vineyard prove it -- not punished with karet, and forbidden for benefit
